name: Sultana Kamal Bridge
facts: Sultana Kamal Bridge, also called the Demra Bridge, opened in June 2010 after four years of construction, and was inaugurated by former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, marking a milestone in Bangladesh’s infrastructure development.
In 2017, a vessel engaged in illegal sand mining collided with five pillars of the Sultana Kamal Bridge, damaging its safety barriers and prompting urgent repairs to protect daily commuters.

The bridge’s 798.8 million taka construction cost—one of three built under a single project—enabled Dhaka’s eastern expansion, easing traffic for commuters from Narsingdi and the greater Sylhet region.
